Add your Claude key

Use your own Anthropic API account for the trainer. Anthropic bills your usage; Block sets no monthly message limit.

Block ProiOS 27

Add a key

You need an API key from the Claude Console, with API credit available. A Claude chat subscription and API billing are separate.

  1. Open the Console. Add credit in Settings > Billing and set a spend limit for your account.
  2. In Settings > API keys, create an API key. Give it a name such as Block and copy it.
  3. In the Block app, open Settings > AI > Your Claude key. Paste the key and tap Verify & save key.
  4. Open the trainer from Today. The status line under the message field shows the model and that it is using your key.

The app checks the key with a small request before it saves it. If the check fails, the field shows the reason. Block needs a regular API key, not an Admin key or a Claude subscription token.

Billing and limits

Anthropic charges your Console account for requests made with your key. You still need Block Pro to use the trainer. Check Anthropic's current API pricing before adding credit.

One question can take several requests as the trainer reads your log or research. Long chats, program builds, and web searches can use more credit. Automatic requests, such as next targets after a session, also use your key.

Set a spend limit in the Console and check its usage page. The app's message counter is not a measure of your API bill.

What your key changes

Your key uses Claude Sonnet 5 for every message. Block does not impose its monthly allowance on those requests. Anthropic's credit balance, account limits, and model access still apply.

The trainer has the same access to your workouts, sessions, rules, and research. You review workout proposals and approve next targets in the same way. A key does not grant more control over your Block account.

If your key cannot answer, the built-in trainer can answer that question instead. A notice tells you why. A reply through Block counts against your Block allowance.

To use your training log in Claude's own app, connect an assistant. That connection does not need this key.

Fix a key problem

Key is not accepted
Copy a regular API key from the Console. Remove any spaces before or after it. Verify that the key has not expired or been revoked.
No credit or spend limit reached
Check Billing and Usage in the Console. Add credit or adjust the limit there if you want more API use.
No access to the model
Check the key's organization and workspace in the Console. They must allow the model used by the trainer.
Works on another iPhone
Keys stay on the iPhone where you save them. Add the key on this phone too.

If the problem remains, contact support with the error text. Do not send your API key.

Privacy and removal

The key is stored in this iPhone's Keychain. It is not stored in Block's database or copied to another phone. Requests made with it go directly to Anthropic, including your question and the training data needed to answer it.

To stop using the key on this phone, open Settings > AI > Your Claude key > Remove key. To revoke the key itself, delete it in the Console. Removing it from Block does not close your Anthropic account.

Read the trainer's privacy terms or return to the AI trainer guide.
